verdict.rationale: Notion publishes a developer reference site (e.g. /reference/webhooks.md) and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json. Its quickstart promises a first API request in under two minutes, so a structured, example-driven API reference is plausible. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run from the docs. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable "try it" examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
